paper_title: Constraining Light QCD Axions with Isolated Neutron Star Cooling
notes: Fig. 5 (e-print file Axion_fa_NS_Cooling.pdf), bright-red NS-cooling exclusion, SOLID contour = conservative limit (g+g_a)_14>100 (the dashed (g+g_a)_14>50 region is slightly larger and was not used). Vector paths extracted from the PDF; axes calibrated from tick marks (x: 43.845 pt/decade with 10^-20 eV at the left spine; y: 38.115 pt/decade with 10^-20 GeV^-1 at the bottom spine). The excluded region is a diagonal band in the (m_a, 1/f_a) plane bounded by two slope-1 lines (the right edge is exactly the eps=0.1 line where the new ground state disappears; the left edge is where the NGS appears only below rho_b) with a rounded tip at m_a~5x10^-9 eV, 1/f_a~7x10^-15 GeV^-1 (f_a~1.4x10^14 GeV). Points trace the physical boundary of this band clipped to the plotted window (10^-20..10 eV, 10^-20..10^-4 GeV^-1): from the left edge's exit at the top of the plot (0.35 eV, 1e-4 GeV^-1), down the left edge, around the tip, then up the right (eps=0.1) edge to its exit at the right spine (10 eV, 5.4e-6 GeV^-1); therefore not monotonic in mass (closed-region boundary). Astrophysical bound; no statistical CL stated in the paper (0.95 is a placeholder) and no dark-matter density assumed (bound does not require the axion to be dark matter).
